pairs.l: 1 — offers expert opinion on the food waste problem?
2 — thinks people should cooperate with local businesses to find the solution?
4 — is extra careful with the money they spend on food?
7 — finds information on food products confusing?
8 — thinks household members are responsible for food waste?
9 — blames both their neighbours and the local government for food waste?
10 — suggests that food should become more expensive?
11 — connects the food waste problem to the rich?
12 — suggests some legal changes concerning food production?

r1.exp: 1=C (Celine: 'Having done A LOT OF RESEARCH INTO THE PROBLEM AT UNIVERSITY'). 2=D (David: 'small shops can be ENCOURAGED TO WORK TOGETHER and REDISTRIBUTE the surplus food'). 3=A (Alan: 'CHECKING the production and use-by dates... is what I CONSIDER CRUCIAL... I'm DETERMINED TO DO IT every time'). 4=E (Eve: 'I always THINK TWICE when buying food... because I DESPISE OVERSPENDING'). 5=F (Fiona: 'it is such a big problem for people to SORT OUT BIODEGRADABLE WASTE and put it in the PROPER BIN'). 6=D (David: 'a food bank or a charity that will be more than happy to help'). 7=A (Alan: 'I find it very difficult to make a DISTINCTION between SELL-BY DATE and USE-BY DATE... has to be an expert... BLURRY PRINT'). 8=B (Ben: 'mostly considered a problem at the FAMILY LEVEL: parents buy too much... mothers cook too much... family members eat out'). 9=F (Fiona: 'What I SEE DAILY IN THE APARTMENT BLOCK worries me... the CITY COUNCIL imposed higher fines'). 10=E (Eve: 'abolition of financial subsidies on food. This will result in a RISE IN FOOD PRICES'). 11=C (Celine: 'one of the main drivers is growing PROSPERITY... citizens of the DEVELOPED WORLD care less'). 12=B (Ben: 'establish BETTER STANDARDS IN FACTORIES AND TRANSPORT... REGULATORY MEASURES').

r13.exp: 'BOTTOM LINE, she NEVER SEEMED TO MAKE ENDS MEET' = nije imala dovoljno prihoda = A (low income).

r14.exp: 'Their male counterparts COULD NOT MATCH' the breathing technique = majstorstvo disanja = D.

r15.exp: 'Women take pills to cope with MOTION SICKNESS... she has found this to be the MOST CHALLENGING PART' = mučnina = A.

r16.exp: 'DEGRADATION OF THE EXISTING UNDERWATER HABITAT... large seaweed has disappeared... marine life to die off' = uništavanje staništa = C.

r17.exp: 'The seas off Korea's southern coast have WARMED' = globalno zatopljenje = C. (Also: young women are leaving, but the KEY says C=global warming as primary cause of the ecological threat.)

r18.exp: 'Korea's PIONEER FEMINISTS... voice in the family structure... democratic community governance and SUSTAINABLE environmental practice' = odlični uzori za feminizam i demokratiju = B.

r19.exp: 'Electric was the FIRST to transform cars. (19)____. HOWEVER, electric cars are now emerging as a MUST-HAVE in all market segments.' → D: When it was FIRST INTRODUCED, experts envisaged a SPECIFIC USE – for electric PUBLIC TRANSPORT for example.

r20.exp: 'The autonomous car — a spectacular revolution. (20)____. First two stages already completed. Cruise control exists.' → A: Tomorrow's cars will be able to DO WITHOUT THEIR DRIVERS. The sentence introduces the concept of full autonomy.

r21.exp: 'Must exchange information with the outside world: traffic, weather, accidents, etc. (21)____. In addition, numerous online services.' → G: Eventually, through various sensors, it will be able to COMMUNICATE WITH OTHER VEHICLES but also with THE INFRASTRUCTURE (roads, buildings, etc.).

r22.exp: 'The last major change concerns THE INDUSTRY ITSELF. (22)____. All the car's hardware and software architecture is being redesigned.' → C: TOMORROW'S FACTORIES will be nothing like they are today.

r23.exp: 'Not just body changing... such as 3D printing materials. (23)____. This means COMPLETELY OVERHAULING the car's electronic architecture.' → F: But ALSO, to ensure the CONNECTIVITY AND RANGE of the vehicle, numerous smart devices will have to be CONNECTED AND INTEGRATED.

r24.exp: 'Completely overhauling the electronic architecture. (24)____. It will bring benefits: less pollution, more safety.' → B: TO SUM UP, the car of the future, built according to a new model, will be ELECTRIC, AUTONOMOUS AND CONNECTED.

r25.exp: 'Character DEVELOPMENT' — fiksna kolokacija: character development = razvoj karaktera/ličnosti.

r26.exp: 'Characters who HAVE INFLUENCED our life from an early age' — present perfect za trajan utjecaj koji seže do sadašnjosti.

r27.exp: 'Dangerous in TERMS OF hidden messages' — fiksni izraz: in terms of = u pogledu, što se tiče.

r28.exp: 'Not MEANT for children' — fiksna kolokacija: be meant for = biti namijenjen za.

r29.exp: 'Had to be ADAPTED' — 'adapt' = prilagoditi (softened versions = adapted for children).

r30.exp: 'Conflict between good and evil, WHICH can be seen as the internal conflict' — ne-restriktivna relativna zamjenica 'which' (uz zarez).

r31.exp: 'The hero NEEDN'T BE a warrior' — 'needn't be' = ne mora biti (not necessary to be a warrior). Example: a girl defeats a wolf.

r32.exp: 'A child can ACQUIRE positive values' — fiksna kolokacija: acquire values = steći vrijednosti.

r33.exp: 'Listening to and PARTICIPATING IN music' — gerund: participating in = sudjelovanje u.

r34.exp: 'Satisfaction that is EXPERIENCED after intense exercise' — passive participle: be experienced = biti iskušeno/osjećano.

r35.exp: 'By supporting a healthy immune system BY reducing the stress hormone cortisol' — 'by' + gerund za načinski prilog.

r36.exp: 'Many HEALING rituals' — 'healing' kao pridjev (healing rituals = obredi liječenja).

r37.exp: 'Everyone can sing, however much we might protest, MEANING that it is one of the most accessible forms' — 'meaning' = što znači (participial clause).

r38.exp: 'Associated WITH activation of the brain's reward system' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: be associated with = biti u vezi s.

r39.exp: 'Singing, EVEN if there is no audience, improves our sense of happiness' — 'even if' = čak i ako (emphatic condition).

r40.exp: 'Our improved mood is likely to be INFLUENCED by changes in our sense of social closeness' — passive: be influenced by = biti pod utjecajem.
